rows: Tung dang-ol do ho O jol-ma a-la ha-la-la-pon-mi, so di bo-to ho ma-go-mu di-ra-ja-i hi-sap i,
lan do ang-ka ha-li-li-an na ma-nai-ti ro-ha-mi, ha-ri-bu-ron ha-u-li-on la-lap ho di hor-hon i,
I-da ma hi-ras-na i tung ne-ang do lang-ka-mi, ma-nge-a-hi ar-ta i, na mang-go-hi ro-ha-mi. A-ha ma la-bam O jol-ma nang di ho-lu-hut-na i, ma-go-po do di u-jung-na mo-lo ma-go ton-di-mi.

verses: Tung dangol do ho O jolma ala halalaponmi,
so di boto ho magomu dirajai hisap i,
lan do angka halilian na manaiti rohami,
haribu ron hauli on lalap ho di horhon i,
Ida ma hirasna i tung neang do langkami,
mangeahi arta i, na manggohi rohami.
Aha ma labam O jolma nang di holuhutna i,
magopo do di ujungna molo mago tondimi.
Ia arta na ummarga ndada disarihon ho,
tung so saut do ho taruli nang suksuk arta di ho,
anggo sere dohot perak, na martingki do sude,
tung so boi tondim mardemak, salpu do ngolum muse.
Arta na ummarga i, Hatta ni Tuhanta i;
i do na manongtong i, na pasonang rohami.
Aha ma labam O jolma, nang di ho luhutna i ?
magopo do di ujungna, molo mago tondimi.
title: Tung dangol do ho O jolma
credit: Syair & Lagu: Pdt. Dr. J.Pardede
status: Lirik dicek · 8/16 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: I-a ar-ta na um-mar-ga nda-da di-sa-ri-hon ho, tung so saut do ho ta-ru-li nang suk-suk ar-ta di ho,
ang-go se-re do-hot pe-rak, na mar-ting-ki do su-de, tung so boi ton-dim mar-de-mak, sal-pu do ngo-lum mu-se.
Ar-ta na um-mar-ga i, Hat-ta ni Tu-han-ta i; i do na ma-nong-tong i, na pa-so-nang ro-ha-mi. A-ha ma la-bam O jol-ma, nang di ho lu-hut-na i? ma-go-po do di u-jung-na, mo-lo ma-go ton-di-mi.

rows: Sai to-gi-hon a-u mu-lak tu A-ma i, nu-nga lo-ja a-u di-par-ja-la-ngan-ki. u-nang lo-as ma-go au di do-sang-ki, sai to-gi-hon mu-lak au tu ba-gas ni A-ma i,
Sai to-gi-hon au. a-sa mu-lak au. a-le Ton-di Par-ba-di-a to-gi-hon mu-lak au.

verses: Sai togihon au mulak tu Ama i,
nunga loja au diparjalanganki.
unang loas mago au di dosangki,
sai togihon mulak au tu bagas ni Ama i,
Refrein : Sai togihon au. asa mulak au.
ale Tondi Parbadia togihon mulak au.
Ale Debatanku baen ma au naposoM,
Taiti ma rohangku lao mangoloi Ho,
Haporseaonku baen gomos tu Ho,
ale Jesus togu ahu, asa jonok tu Ho.
Refrein : Sai togihon . . .
title: Sai togihon au mulak

r: A-le De-ba-tan-ku baen ma au na-po-soM, Tai-ti ma ro-hang-ku lao ma-ngo-loi Ho, Ha-por-se-a-on-ku baen go-mos tu Ho, a-le Je-sus to-gu a-hu, a-sa jo-nok tu Ho. rein:
Sai to-gi-hon au. a-sa mu-lak au. a-le Ton-di Par-ba-di-a to-gi-hon mu-lak au.
